text:
Mira Patel: Hi everyone  Im Mira, joining as a Developer Advocate. Very excited! Quick Qs for day zero: who do I ping for VPN and repo access? Also is there a way to reserve a quiet meeting room for my 4pm intro call? :wave:
Jules Park: welcome Mira!! For access ping #eng-infra and drop your public ssh key if you want it pre-authorized. For room reservations use the Calendar app (search: Quiet Room - 2). If you want, I can book it for you at 3:50 so you have time to test audio.
Mira Patel: thanks Jules, can you book 3:50 then? Also curious about laptop delivery  is it typical to get it day 0?
Samir Rao: hey Mira  Samir from IT. Laptops sometimes arrive day 0, sometimes day 1 depending on courier. DM me your tracking and Ill chase. For VPN we also need your employee ID once HR finishes provisioning.
Mira Patel: DM sent with tracking. dropping pubkey here to speed up repo access:
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEfakeExampleKeyMira mira@home
```
Carmen Li: hi Mira  Carmen from People Ops. Welcome! Badge will be at reception after 10:30. If youd like the desk plant, reply "plant: yes" and well include a small philodendron. Also we have an accessibility checkbox on equipment orders  reply "ergonomic: mouse" if you need a vertical mouse.
Mira Patel: plant: yes. ergonomic: mouse please  and thanks for the heads up re: badge.
Jules Park: booked Quiet Room - 2 for 3:50. Also we do a small new-hire intro slack lightning round at 12 — optional but fun.
Mira Patel: Ill join lunch. lightning round fun facts: two truths & a lie: I once coded a game jam in 24hrs, I have a twin, I cant parallel park.
Samir Rao: nice! my guess: twin = lie?
Carmen Li: bet the parking is the lie  twins are common in your neighborhood :)
Mira Patel: reveal: I do have a twin (true), I can parallel park (true), fake = coded a game jam in 24hrs (Ive done hackathons but never that short). Thanks all  will ping #eng-infra if anything blocks.
OnboarderBot: Welcome Mira Patel. New-hire checklist started. IT ticket IT-5128 opened for asset tracking. Reminder: complete security training by day 5.
FacilitiesBot: Mira Patel  desk D-21 assigned. Badge pickup at reception. Plant request queued. If you need fast access to a headset, reply "headset: urgent" and Facilities will drop one at reception.
Mira Patel: headset: urgent  appreciate it! See you at lunch :bento:
